findings.what: A P0 finding is passed to VerdictCard as P2 (`f.severity === 'P1' ? 'P1' : 'P2'`), so the page's own findings region says P0 while its verdict card says P2.
findings.why: LOOP-3 says each verdict is rendered from its JSON. The verdict schema allows P0 (rule broken or exploitable), and this code would show it as the least severe level. Ladder.tsx:85 has the same coercion, so the loop and node pages show it too. The kit's VerdictCard takes only 'P1' | 'P2' (VerdictCard.tsx:14). react-web says a missing kit variant is reported as a kit change, never worked around in the screen, and HONEST-1 can't be waived. No fixture verdict holds a P0 and no test asserts severity, so the suite can't see this.

findings.what: Every node's loop page says 'each event recorded by the orchestrator', but 37 events in 7 real loop logs have source 'reconciled', and the compiled `source` field is ignored.
findings.why: DATA-2 keeps each item's provenance, and HONEST-1 forbids a name the trail doesn't hold. The reference sentence was true for the design fixture's F3. The screen turned it into a fixed claim for every node, including build/F1 (lines 56-72), F0b, U0b, U1, U3 (line 29) and W1, whose reconciled lines were added afterwards.

findings.what: resultOf maps a gate event with no recorded ok to 'waived', which the kit words as 'Waived' (the gate did not run). The log records no waiver, and the code's own comment says 'did not decide'.
findings.why: LOOP-1 shows ok as the line records it. The kit's GateRow defines waived as 'the gate was waived, so it did not run' (GateRow.tsx:11), which is a claim the log line doesn't make. No real gate line lacks ok today, so nothing shows it yet.

findings.what: A finding whose testable is null is passed to FindingCard as testable=false, so the card is headed 'Untestable' while the line above it says 'testable: not recorded'.
findings.why: LOOP-4 shows 'testable or not' as recorded. Turning null into false invents an untestable verdict (HONEST-1), and the page then contradicts itself. The compiler keeps testable null when the round doesn't hold a boolean (compiler/index.ts).
